spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: Per time bucket: true when the signal was true at any moment in that bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin('$__interval', timestamp, TIMESTAMP '1970-01-01') AS time,
  max(chlorine_unit_alarm__value) AS "Chlorine unit"
FROM marpower__250000_tech_water__general
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Alarms
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM marpower__250000_tech_water__general
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN CASE l.chlorine_unit_alarm__value WHEN true THEN 'Active' WHEN false THEN 'No' END
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(l.timestamp) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Chlorine unit', 'chlorine_unit_alarm', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
LEFT JOIN m ON m.mqtt_json_path = s.path
ORDER BY s.n

spec.title: Flow
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Analog values are rounded to 2 decimals; units are in the signal name.

spec.rawSql:
WITH g0 AS (
  SELECT
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b03' THEN v END) AS v1,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b03' THEN ts END) AS t1,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b07' THEN v END) AS v2,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b07' THEN ts END) AS t2,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b08' THEN v END) AS v3,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b08' THEN ts END) AS t3,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b09' THEN v END) AS v4,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-adiabatic-cooling-line-b09' THEN ts END) AS t4,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-reel-deckwash-aft' THEN v END) AS v5,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-reel-deckwash-aft' THEN ts END) AS t5,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-reel-deckwash-mid' THEN v END) AS v6,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-reel-deckwash-mid' THEN ts END) AS t6,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-reel-deckwash-fwd' THEN v END) AS v7,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-reel-deckwash-fwd' THEN ts END) AS t7,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-charcoal-filter' THEN v END) AS v8,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'cold-flow-charcoal-filter' THEN ts END) AS t8
  FROM (
    SELECT technical_name AS k, last_value(flow__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS v, max(timestamp) AS ts
    FROM marpower__tech_water__flows
    WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
    GROUP BY technical_name
  ) AS x
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v1, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 2 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v2, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 3 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v3, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 4 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v4, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 5 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v5, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 6 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v6, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 7 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v7, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 8 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v8, 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN g0.t1
    WHEN 2 THEN g0.t2
    WHEN 3 THEN g0.t3
    WHEN 4 THEN g0.t4
    WHEN 5 THEN g0.t5
    WHEN 6 THEN g0.t6
    WHEN 7 THEN g0.t7
    WHEN 8 THEN g0.t8
  END) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Adiabatic cooling B03 [L/min]', 'adiabatic_cool_b03_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Adiabatic cooling B07 [L/min]', 'adiabatic_cool_b07_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Adiabatic cooling B08 [L/min]', 'adiabatic_cool_b08_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'Adiabatic cooling B09 [L/min]', 'adiabatic_cool_b09_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (5, 'Deckwash reel B06 [L/min]', 'reel_for_deckwash_b06_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (6, 'Deckwash reel MID [L/min]', 'reel_for_deckwash_b05_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (7, 'Deckwash reel FWD [L/min]', 'reel_for_deckwash_b04_flow', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (8, 'Charcoal filter [L/min]', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'), '25004037_4')
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN g0 ON true
LEFT JOIN m ON m.mqtt_json_path = s.path
ORDER BY s.n

spec.title: Miscellaneous
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest message. Analog values are rounded to 2 decimals; units are in the signal name.

spec.rawSql:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT * FROM marpower__250000_tech_water__general
  WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
g0 AS (
  SELECT
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'clean-level' THEN v END) AS v4,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'clean-level' THEN ts END) AS t4,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'dirty-level' THEN v END) AS v5,
    max(CASE WHEN k = 'dirty-level' THEN ts END) AS t5
  FROM (
    SELECT technical_name AS k, last_value(level__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS v, max(timestamp) AS ts
    FROM public.marpower__tech_water__level_sensors
    WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' 
    GROUP BY technical_name
  ) AS x
),
m AS (
  SELECT mqtt_json_path, max(yard_tag) AS yard_tag FROM public.marpower__io_metadata
  WHERE mqtt_topic = 'marpower/250000-techwater' GROUP BY mqtt_json_path
)
SELECT s.signal AS "Signal",
  coalesce(m.yard_tag, s.tag) AS "Tag",
  CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.charcoal_filter_b_02_temp__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 2 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.salinity_1__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 3 THEN arrow_cast(round(l.salinity_2__value, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 4 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v4, 2), 'Utf8')
    WHEN 5 THEN arrow_cast(round(g0.v5, 2), 'Utf8')
  END AS "State",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(CASE s.n
    WHEN 1 THEN l.timestamp
    WHEN 2 THEN l.timestamp
    WHEN 3 THEN l.timestamp
    WHEN 4 THEN g0.t4
    WHEN 5 THEN g0.t5
  END) AS "Updated"
FROM (VALUES
  (1, 'Charcoal filter - Temp. [°C]', 'charcoal_filter_b02_temp', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (2, 'Salinity 1 [g/m³]', 'salinity1', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (3, 'Salinity 2 [g/m³]', 'salinity2', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (4, 'Clean water tank [L]', 'tank1_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8')),
  (5, 'Dirty water tank [L]', 'tank2_level', arrow_cast(NULL, 'Utf8'))
) AS s(n, signal, path, tag)
LEFT JOIN l ON true
LEFT JOIN g0 ON true
LEFT JOIN m ON m.mqtt_json_path = s.path
ORDER BY s.n

		technical_name AS name,
		level__value   AS level

	ORDER BY technical_name, timestamp DESC

spec.name: live_window
spec.description: How far back the Live tabs look for the latest message, independent of the time picker. The Live tables' no-data text ('No data in the last 5 minutes') repeats this value.
